For versatile connectivity, the HP 14 comes with USB-C, 2x USB-A, HDMI 1.4, a power connector, and an audio combo jack, plus Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.4 for fast, reliable wireless performance. Running on Windows 11 Home in S mode—designed for optimal security and performance—this laptop can be switched out of S mode to Windows 11 Home by opening Windows Settings > System > Activation, making it ideal for a range of uses including family entertainment, school education, daily productivity, casual gaming, streaming, online classes, remote learning, Zoom meetings, and video conferences.
